mapper.select: SELECT FROM qualification_criterion c WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.dimension, c.position, c.id
SELECT FROM qualification_criterion c WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY c.dimension, c.position, c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qualification_criterion (workspace_id, label, dimension, weight, required, position) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{label}, #{dimension}, #{weight}, #{required}, #{position})
mapper.update: UPDATE qualification_criterion SET label = #{label}, dimension = #{dimension}, weight = #{weight}, required = #{required}, position = #{position} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
UPDATE qualification_criterion SET archived_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND archived_at IS NULL
